caption: Hey, I'm Aditya.
Let me tell you how I got here.
I was always the analytical kid.|Math, science, building fun stuff.
So: engineering.
But I also loved investing,|and how money moves the world.
So I added economics.
Then, five years at HARMAN in Bengaluru,|building navigation for cars and trucks.
When a truck's camera can't see a speed sign,|our map data still knows it.
But I kept having business doubts.
As an engineer, you get tasks, not a vote.
A lot of effort went into things|that just didn't make business sense.
I wanted to help decide what gets built,|not just how.
So: I recalculated.
In 2025, I moved to the US.
It's where AI is being built,|and I wanted to be there.
At Duke, I picked up the business side:|strategy, finance, marketing.
Design Thinking taught me|how to really interview customers.
After 15+ interviews, the lesson was simple.
People weren't missing information.|They were missing trust.
On the side, I'm a little obsessed|with credit card points.
I was optimizing everything by hand,|and couldn't find a tool that did it.
So I built one: PointsMax.
Next stop?
A team that moves fast, has fun,|and makes a real dent.
Maybe yours.
